messages:
Maya: Draft is up in Drive — ~2.1k words. Fast pass requested: hero claim, CTA, bench callouts. Link: https://drive.redwood/release-post-draft

Chris: skimmed — looks good. Note: benchmarks are from our Q4 perf run using the internal test harness (will add appendix).

Linh: CTA suggestion: Primary = 'Start for free', Secondary = 'Register for the launch webinar'. Need webinar link and UTM plan.

Emily: Legal quick flag: hero '3x' claim needs clear test parameters. Also avoid ambiguous term 'baseline'. Please provide test config and date.

Maya: Suggested tweak to claim: `Redwood reduces inference spend by up to 3x vs a single-GPU baseline (Llama2-70B, mixed precision).` Better?

Chris: That reads clearer. I'll paste the bench snippet to reference in the appendix — can you include it under 'Benchmark appendix'?

Chris: ```
Model        | Setup            | Median cost reduction
Llama2-70B  | 8x A100 equiv     | 2.8x
Llama2-13B  | 4x T4 equiv       | 1.6x
Benchmark run date: 2025-02-14 (internal harness v3.2)
```

Emily: Much better. Couple edits: spell out hardware vendor (e.g., NVIDIA A100), include the exact query distribution and prompt set name, and we need a short disclaimer: 'Results based on internal tests; actual results may vary.'

ops-bot: Asset lock set by maya until 2025-02-21T17:00:00Z :lock:

Linh: Webinar reg URL (draft): https://register.redwood/events/launch?utm_campaign=post_launch&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta — we'll append campaign params per audience.

Maya: Can we finalize by EOD today? Legal + product edits, then I'll push to CMS and queue socials.

Chris: Will update appendix with exact harness commands and sample prompts.

Emily: Approve pending: (1) exact test config + date added to appendix, (2) replace 'single-GPU baseline' with 'single-GPU configuration' or specify the exact baseline, (3) include the disclaimer line.

Maya: Acknowledged. Final hero claim updated to: `Redwood cuts inference spend by up to 3x in batch-heavy workloads (see benchmark appendix).` I'll add the appendix details and the disclaimer, then lock the post and hand off to creative for hero image.

Linh: I'll prep two CTA variants and the email capture flow. If we're good, I'll also draft the HubSpot workflow for inbound leads.

Maya: Perfect — thanks everyone :raised_hands: Once legal confirms the appendix text I'll publish to the staging CMS and ping the #ops channel for the publish window.

Emily: Will review appendix now and reply with final OK shortly.

Maya: timeline note: targeting publish Wed 09:00 PT. Ops, can we reserve that window?

ops-bot: Publish window reserved 2025-02-26T09:00:00-08:00 by ops-team :calendar:

Maya: Great — locking this thread. Final edits will be pushed to the drive file and I'll update the social snippets after publish sign-off.
